untrustedWorkspaces.description: Project plugins, hooks and instruction files are not loaded in untrusted workspaces. Tool calls still follow the configured approval policy and OS sandbox.

comonad.mode.markdownDescription: Tool capabilities. `chat` no tools at all · `ro` read files, read-only shell · `sw` write files, run tests in a scratch shell · `aw` write files, full shell · `pl` read files, read-only shell, plan files only.

comonad.approval.markdownDescription: What happens after the mode allows a tool call: `manual` asks for every call, `whitelist_accept` runs the whitelisted calls (`permissions.allow`, plus read-only calls by default) and asks for the rest, `blacklist_reject` rejects the write-capable calls by default (plus whatever `permissions.deny` names) and runs the rest, `universal_accept` runs everything the mode allows, `universal_reject` runs nothing.

comonad.network.description: Allow tools that need network access, and network inside the shell sandbox. When off, loopback connections stay available so local test servers work.

comonad.workingDirectory.description: Working directory for file and shell tools. Empty uses the first workspace folder.

comonad.commandTimeout.description: Shell command timeout in seconds. The fallback when a foreground shell tool omits its per-call timeout, and the fixed value when comonad.commandTimeoutOverride is on.

comonad.commandTimeoutOverride.description: Use comonad.commandTimeout for every foreground shell call and ignore a timeout the model asks for. When off, the model chooses a timeout per call (clamped to 1-300 seconds), with comonad.commandTimeout as the fallback. Background tasks started with start_shell have no timeout.

comonad.denyReadPaths.description: Workspace-relative paths or basenames that file and shell tools must not read or write.

comonad.confineRead.description: Restrict reads to the workspace. With this on, the file tools refuse paths outside the working directory and the shell sandbox cannot read outside it, which can break commands that read ~/.gitconfig, ~/.npmrc and similar.

comonad.confineWrite.description: Restrict writes to the workspace. With this on, the file tools refuse paths outside the working directory and the shell sandbox cannot write outside it.

comonad.maxSteps.markdownDescription: Maximum graph steps per turn. `0` means no limit.

enumDescriptions: Subagents share the turn's Max steps.
Subagents spend the budget in comonad.subagentSteps.
comonad.subagentStepsMode.markdownDescription: Where a subagent's step budget comes from: the turn's `maxSteps` (`inherit`) or `comonad.subagentSteps` (`custom`). A definition's `maxTurns` can only tighten it.

comonad.subagentSteps.markdownDescription: Steps a subagent may take when `comonad.subagentStepsMode` is `custom`. `0` means no limit.

comonad.planDirectory.description: Workspace-relative folder for plan files. Empty uses .comonad/plans.

comonad.graph.markdownDescription: Mermaid source for the Graph plugin's named agent loops. Empty uses the shipped `agent` graph. Edit it in Settings → Graph.

workflows.name: Standard coding task
workflows.description: Research, plan and approve, implement, verify, then review.

stages.title: Research
stages.objective: Investigate the workspace before changing anything. Find the relevant files, symbols, call paths, tests and conventions. Report what exists, where the change belongs, and the constraints. Do not edit.

stages.title: Plan
stages.objective: Write a concrete implementation plan for the task. List the files to change, ordered steps, edge cases, and how the change will be verified. Keep it short enough to act on. Do not edit project files.

stages.title: Implement
stages.objective: Implement the task, following the plan. If the plan is wrong, adapt it. Use the file tools for project changes. Keep edits focused and the workspace buildable. Finish with a short summary of what changed.

stages.title: Review
stages.objective: Review the changes made in this turn. Read the diff and changed files. Report defects by severity with file:line references. Then give the final report: what changed, what verification showed, and any remaining issues. If verification failed, say so explicitly.

comonad.workflows.markdownDescription: The workflow library: named workflows, each a list of agent or checks stages. `enabled` turns automatic runs on or off; `default` names the workflow auto/always uses. Edit it visually in Settings → Workflow.

comonad.model.description: `auto` for the first profile, a profile id for its default model, or `profile:model` for a model the endpoint lists.

comonad.profiles.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible endpoints to chat with. The model menu is read from each endpoint (`GET /models`), so a new model needs no configuration; a profile's `model` is what a bare profile id selects. Empty uses the shipped profiles (DeepSeek Flash first, so **Auto** runs on it). A key stored with **Comonad: Configure Model Provider** belongs to the endpoint and every profile with the same normalized `base` shares it; without a stored key, the variables in `keyEnv` are tried in order.

provider.description: Model adapter to run this profile; `openai` is the built-in one.

model.description: The model a bare profile id selects; the menu itself lists what the endpoint reports.

modelPrefix.description: Prefix the endpoint puts on the ids it reports, stripped so the menu and requests use the plain name (Gemini: `models/`).

modelSkip.description: Regex of reported model ids to leave out of the menu — providers list models that cannot run a chat turn.

keyEnv.description: Environment variable(s) holding the API key, in order, when no key is stored for this endpoint.

thinkingOff.description: How this endpoint turns thinking off for the `none` reasoning effort: DeepSeek's `thinking` field, or `reasoning_effort: "none"` (`effort`).

topEffort.description: The deepest thinking level this endpoint accepts. A pick above it runs at this level; leave it unset to send the pick unchanged.

contextWindow.description: The provider's input window in tokens, used for the chat's context budget and the model menu's `Auto (…)`.

pricingIn.description: USD per million input tokens (cache miss), for /cost estimates.

pricingCachedIn.description: USD per million input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache.

pricingOut.description: USD per million output tokens, for /cost estimates.

comonad.permissions.description: Permission rules such as `run_shell(npm run test:*)`, `read_file(./.env)`, `fetch_url(domain:example.com)`.

files.description: Grant the tracked file-write tools (write_file, apply_patch, apply_edits).

test.description: Grant run_shell_test: the workspace stays read-only and only the scratch directory is writable.

comonad.subagents.markdownDescription: Per-agent capability grants for subagents, keyed by agent name. `files` enables the tracked file-write tools; `test` enables the scratch-only test shell. Read-only tools are always available; full shell (`run_shell`, `start_shell`) and plan writes are never granted to a subagent. The agent's own `tools` list still selects which tools it uses, and the parent mode still has to allow the capability. Built-in `implement` defaults to both; every other agent defaults to read-only. Example: `{ "implement": { "files": true, "test": true } }`.

comonad.instructions.description: Load COMONAD.md, AGENTS.md and .comonad/rules into the system prompt (trusted workspaces only).

comonad.memory.description: Load and let the agent update project memory.

comonad.prompts.description: Comonad prompt blocks: their order, their switch, and the static prefix each one opens with. The dynamic content is generated every turn and is not stored here.

comonad.toolPrompts.description: Tool order and per-tool switches for the request. A tool's definition still comes from the plugin that registers it; this setting only decides whether and where it is offered.

comonad.checkpoints.description: Journal every file the agent writes (per file, not per turn) so the review can keep or undo them, and an edited prompt can restore them. Needs the Change journal plugin row — install it from Settings → Plugins → Install…; the setting only pauses a journal that is there. Changes made by shell commands are not tracked.

comonad.inlineDiff.description: Show the agent's changes inline in the editor: changed blocks are painted, and Keep / Undo sit above each block and at the top of the file. Needs the Change journal row; turning it off leaves the QuickPick review and the Git Changes view.

comonad.chatWindow.description: Open the Comonad chat in its own floating window when it is opened as an editor tab.

comonad.contextForm.markdownDescription: What a chat sends back to the model: `rendered` trims long tool output, `token` sends only user/assistant text, `raw` sends the full record. New chats start here; the composer's Context pill changes the current chat and saves the pick here.

comonad.displayForm.markdownDescription: How a reply is shown: `rendered` folds thoughts and draws each tool call as a card, `token` shows assistant text only, `raw` shows the full record. New replies start here; the tabs above a reply switch just that reply.

comonad.toolCard.markdownDescription: How a tool call is drawn when it first appears: `collapsed` shows only the header (the default), `preview` folds the card and shows the first lines of its output, and `open` expands the command and output. A click still toggles an individual card.

comonad.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: Thinking effort: `auto` uses the provider default, `none` turns thinking off where the model allows it, and `max` runs as deep as the endpoint goes (capped by the profile's `topEffort`). New chats start here; the model menu changes the current chat and saves the pick here.

comonad.contextWindow.markdownDescription: Overrides the model's input window in tokens. `0` uses the window on the model profile, falling back to 128K for a model that has none. The chat summarizes itself when the request no longer fits. New chats start here; the model menu changes the current chat and saves the pick here.

comonad.budgetUsd.description: Warn when the estimated session cost passes this many USD (0 disables). Profiles need pricingIn/pricingOut.

comonad.filterSensitiveEnv.description: Remove API keys, tokens and other secrets from the environment of sandboxed commands and background tasks.

comonad.allowFullAccess.description: Offer the unrestricted preset. Set to false to keep the agent behind approvals and sandboxing.

comonad.allowUnsandboxedShell.description: Run shell commands without the extra confirmation when no OS sandbox is available (Windows, or Linux/macOS without bwrap/sandbox-exec). Off by default. Tools named *_unsandboxed always ask.

comonad.tavernEnabled.markdownDescription: Compose every turn with the ST prompt collection: Comonad's blocks, a character, world books, a persona and a preset. With no preset selected the built-in **Default** is used. Off sends the agent prompt on its own.

comonad.tavernCharacter.markdownDescription: Default character for new chats: the card's file name or its `name`. Use **Comonad: Pick Character** to choose per chat.

comonad.tavernPersona.markdownDescription: Default user persona for new chats, by file name or title.

comonad.tavernUserName.description: What the {{user}} macro expands to when no persona is selected.

comonad.personaAutoLock.description: Lock a persona to the chat as soon as it is picked, the way SillyTavern's Auto-lock does.

comonad.personaAllowMultiConnections.description: Allow more than one persona to be connected to the same character.

comonad.personaShowNotifications.description: Tell the user when the chat's persona changes.

comonad.tavernLorebooks.description: World books scanned for every chat that does not pick its own.

comonad.tavernPreset.description: Default OpenAI preset (prompts, order and samplers) for new chats, by file name. Empty uses the built-in Default.

comonad.tavernAuthorNote.description: Standing instruction injected into the chat at comonad.tavernNoteDepth, like Author's Note.

comonad.tavernNoteDepth.description: How many messages from the end the author's note is injected at.

comonad.tavernWiFormat.markdownDescription: Wrapper applied to activated world-book entries, e.g. `[Details: {0}]`.

comonad.tavernScenarioFormat.description: Wrapper applied to the card's scenario before it is injected.

comonad.tavernPersonalityFormat.description: Wrapper applied to the card's personality before it is injected.

comonad.tavernRegex.markdownDescription: Regex scripts applied to the prompt or to replies. The same shape SillyTavern stores: `{ scriptName, findRegex, replaceString, placement, disabled, markdownOnly, promptOnly, runOnEdit, minDepth, maxDepth, trimStrings }`.

comonad.tokenizerDir.markdownDescription: A SillyTavern folder whose `src/tokenizers` holds the tokenizers it ships itself — Gemma/Gemini, Llama3, Claude, Llama, Mistral, Yi, Jamba. Models with a published tokenizer (DeepSeek, Qwen2, Command R/A, Nemo, GLM) are downloaded and cached instead, and OpenAI-family models use `tiktoken`'s encodings. Empty means those models are counted with SillyTavern's own fallback estimate (bytes / 3.35).

comonad.wiScanDepth.description: How many recent messages the world-info scan reads for keywords.

comonad.wiBudget.description: Percentage of the context window world-book entries may occupy (0 disables the budget).

comonad.wiBudgetCap.description: Hard cap in tokens on world-book entries, whatever the percentage allows (0 disables the cap).

comonad.wiRecursive.description: Let activated entries scan the newest messages in turn and activate more.

comonad.wiMinActivations.description: Keep scanning further back until this many entries are active (0 disables).

comonad.wiMaxActivationsDepth.description: How far back the minimum-activations scan may look, in messages.

comonad.wiMatchWholeWords.description: Require whole words when matching world-book keys.

comonad.wiIncludeNames.description: Prefix injected world-book entries with their title.

comonad.wiCharacterStrategy.markdownDescription: How character-bound and global books interleave: `0` sorted evenly, `1` character lore first, `2` global lore first.

comonad.wiGroupScoring.description: Score a group's entries together instead of keeping only its strongest member.

comonad.wiOverflowAlert.markdownDescription: Say so when the world-info scan ran out of budget and dropped entries (SillyTavern's *Alert On Overflow*).

comonad.wiAutomation.markdownDescription: Run the automation an activated entry names in its *Automation ID*: the `WorldInfoActivated` hook, then a slash command of that name. Off by default — naming an automation is enough to run it.

comonad.wiVectorEnabled.markdownDescription: Find world-info entries marked *Vectorized* by meaning instead of by keys, the way SillyTavern's Vectors extension does. Needs an endpoint that embeds.

comonad.wiVectorProfile.markdownDescription: The profile whose endpoint embeds. Empty means the chat's own model profile — set this when that endpoint has no embeddings.

comonad.wiVectorModel.description: The embedding model to ask for.

comonad.wiVectorThreshold.markdownDescription: The lowest cosine similarity an entry needs to be injected (SillyTavern's *Score threshold*).

comonad.wiVectorMaxEntries.description: How many vectorized entries one book may contribute to a turn.

comonad.wiVectorQuery.description: How many of the newest messages of the chat form the search query.

enumDescriptions: Ask every time a card's own tags could be imported.
Import every tag a card carries, creating the ones that are new.
Import only the card tags that already exist as tags in the library.
comonad.tagImportSetting.markdownDescription: What to do with the tags a character card carries in its own `tags` field (SillyTavern's *Tag Import Option*): `1` ask, `2` none, `3` all, `4` only existing.
